CHAPTER.VERS: For Yahweh Most High is awesome; He is a great King over all the earth.
He subdues peoples under us, And nations under our feet.
He chooses our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing Praise to God, sing praises: Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
God reigns over the nations: God sits on his holy throne.
The princes of the peoples are gathered together [To be] the people of the God of Abraham: For the shields of the earth belong to God; He is greatly exalted.
